title: Careers page
subtitle: Your organisation's public page: your open jobs, your photos and what you offer.
notBusiness: This account isn't a business account.
lockedTitle: Your page opens as soon as your organisation is verified.
lockedText: You'll then be able to add a cover photo, your presentation, photos and your benefits, and share its link.
loadFailed: Your careers page couldn't be loaded.

address.title: Page address
address.hint: Share it where your candidates are: WhatsApp, Facebook, a poster, your website.

distribute.off: Your jobs are no longer distributed.
distribute.label: Distribute my jobs on Google and job sites
distribute.text: Your open jobs show up in job searches. Applications arrive here, like the others.

progress.title: Complete your page
progress.completeText: Candidates see who you are before applying.
progress.text: A complete page builds trust and attracts more candidates.

cover.title: Cover photo
cover.hint: At the top of the page, in a wide format: your premises, your team, your site.
cover.format: Wide format · JPG, PNG or WEBP · 8 MB at most

presentation.title: Presentation
presentation.hint: Activity, missions, values: what candidates should know about you.
presentation.placeholder: E.g. Family restaurant in Brazzaville since 2012, we serve 300 meals a day…

photos.title: Photos
photos.hint: Daily life with you: the team at work, the premises, an event.

benefits.title: Benefits
benefits.hint: What you offer on top of the salary.
benefits.already: This benefit is already on your page.
benefits.placeholder: A benefit, for example: year-end bonus
